title: Independent Architecture source/rationale receipt, one per raw answer
description: Private write-once 0600 receipt bound to slot and raw SHA256. accepted_ids, rejected_ids and source_conflict_ids must be mutually disjoint subsets of the comparison's 37 IDs; unknown/duplicate IDs are refused. Missing IDs stay unreviewed: success requires all 37 independently accepted in all six receipts (222), not a sample or copied vote. Apply the frozen plan's source/rationale checklist (attribution, scope/population/unit/range, polarity, precedence, real ambiguity/unknown handling, joint-section necessity, literal quote relevance and rationale sufficiency). source_conflict_ids means an unjustifiable frozen expectation: stop/preserve; no majority repair, removal, relabel or threshold change. D3 does not compare span/rationale bytes.
